name: Gloomreach
summary: Gloomreach is a cave with entrances in the Reach and Blackreach: Arkthzand Cavern, containing Falmer and wildlife. Volatile tonal energies are disturbing the cave, following the arrival of two Psijic Order members and a relic they brought with them. Multiple passive critters, most of them Blackreach-themed, can be found inside, consisting of; Blackreach Jelly, Centipede, Glow Bug, Nixad, Rat, Spider, Torchbug, Vale Deer Buck, and Vale Deer Doe. When you enter the delve, you'll end up in the central-northern chamber. In this room, the entrance from the Reach lies to the west, and the entrance from Blackreach lies to the south. Calis's Journal is located on a slope beside a tree in the center of this room. The eastern half of the delve is full of Falmer and chaurus. The southern-central chamber contains animals, and the southwestern chambers are where gloomspore creatures reside. Master Pythis's Journal is located upon a table in the southwestern chamber.
